description: Lists dated compliance deadlines from the frag.hugo deadline calendar (GDPR, NIS2, AI Act, CRA, DORA, Data Act, accessibility act and more), each with legal provision, status, what to do and the official source. Without date filters it returns the next upcoming deadlines from today. Not for deadlines of an individual company (data breach, data subject request); those need an account.

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

status.description: in-kraft = in force, kommt = upcoming, verschoben = postponed, entwurf = draft

von.description: From date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today, unless "status" is set

zielgruppe.description: Target group (Zielgruppe); deadlines for "alle" are always included

name: get_compliance_deadlines

naechste_pruefung.description: Date of the next scheduled review of the calendar

rueckfall.description: true = live export unreachable, last good copy served

title: Compliance deadlines (Fristenkalender)
